name: Tyrant
intro: The Tyrant pathway commands storms, lightning and overwhelming physical force. It is built around direct combat, destructive authority and battlefield dominance.

meter.name: Wrath
meter.spend: Lightning Bolt against a Soaked enemy
meter.full: Consume Soaked and chain Lightning to one other enemy

ability.name: Sea-Born Body
ability.label: Passive
ability.description: Sea-Born Body — +10% Max HP; +10% Water direct-damage resistance, +10% Lightning direct-damage resistance. Passive.

ability.name: Raging Blow
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Raging Blow — Deals 165% ATK + 30% INT Water damage (22% base DEF bypass); Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 15 SP · Cooldown 1 turn.

ability.name: Wind Step
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Wind Step — +20 percentage points Dodge for 2 turns; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 25 SP · Cooldown 2 turns.

ability.name: Lightning Bolt
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Lightning Bolt — Deals 200% ATK + 30% INT Lightning damage (22% base DEF bypass); 30% chance: Stunned (blocks actions) for 1 turn; subject to status resistance and immunity; At 100 charge, consume Soaked and chain 50% INT Lightning damage to one additional foe.; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 35 SP · Cooldown 2 turns.

ability.name: Ocean Calling
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Ocean Calling — Deals 220% × (105% ATK + 30% INT) Water damage (22% base DEF bypass); Enemy SPEED −20% for 2 turns; Apply Soaked for 2 turns. Lightning consumes it.; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 45 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Interdiction Roar
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Interdiction Roar — Targets all enemies; Deals 210% ATK + 35% INT Lightning damage (22% base DEF bypass); Enemy DEF −25% for 2 turns; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 50 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Thunder God Stance
ability.label: Active Stance
ability.description: Thunder God Stance — +20% DEF for 2 turns; Reflects 80% × (105% ATK + 30% INT) Lightning damage to the attacker until your next turn; periodic damage does not trigger reflection; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 65 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Tidal Surge
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Tidal Surge — Deals 300% × (105% ATK + 30% INT) Water damage (22% base DEF bypass); Moves the target 3 distance farther away; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 85 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Lightning Storm
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Lightning Storm — Deals 370% ATK + 30% INT Lightning damage (22% base DEF bypass); Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 100 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Thunder God Cataclysm
ability.label: Active Authority
ability.description: Thunder God Cataclysm — Targets all enemies; Deals 460% × (105% ATK + 30% INT) True damage (ignores DEF and elemental resistance); Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 125 SP · Cooldown 5 turns.
